items.title: Land isolated-clone runtime
items.exit_criteria: Standalone install, test, frontend and desktop packaging pass from main.

items.title: Reconcile GUI parity against current main
items.exit_criteria: Current main has a valid parity ratchet and every legacy gap is classified or reduced.

items.title: Add typed error taxonomy
items.exit_criteria: Broad and bare exception paths use typed errors with tests and stable reporting.

items.title: Add checkpoint and resume
items.exit_criteria: Long runs resume from content-bound checkpoints and reject tampered or incompatible state.

items.title: Add data-policy export lint
items.exit_criteria: CI rejects exported content violating DATA_POLICY redaction rules.

items.title: Add GeoPackage and map previews
items.exit_criteria: Local GeoJSON produces deterministic GPKG and preview artifacts with tests.

items.title: Implement geo-anchors v2
items.exit_criteria: OCR-matched anchors produce bounded homographies with rejection and uncertainty evidence.

items.title: Replace fixed hydro and infrastructure proxies
items.exit_criteria: Scores derive from licensed, provenance-bound infrastructure and hydrology layers rather than constants or geometry-only proxies.
